No test in the packet checks the validation rules.

terms.meaning: a rule set that checks data has the right shape and allowed values
a named shape for data, so the code knows which fields exist
a fixed list of allowed values
map coordinates, the north-south and east-west position of a place

sections.name: File setup, themes
sections.title: The allowed theme names
sections.what: Imports the schema tools and lists the seven allowed themes, such as Delivery recovery, Procurement and Financing.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps findings in a fixed vocabulary so search and filters line up.
sections.watch_out: Renaming a theme here breaks any saved findings that use the old name.

sections.name: OpportunitySource
sections.title: Shape of a cited source
sections.what: Describes one web source behind a finding: its title, address, publisher, exact quote, when it was checked, its status, and optional publication date and links to internal evidence records.
sections.why: Likely reason: every claim needs a source that can be traced back to a web page.
sections.watch_out: Only the fetched status is created by the research code shown here, so treat other status values with care.

sections.name: findingSchema, Finding
sections.title: Rules a finding must meet
sections.what: Sets the limits a model-written finding must meet: title and summary lengths, kind (problem, opportunity or whitespace), one to three audiences, confidence, priority from 1 to 100, one to three themes, one to five quotes of 40 to 1,600 characters, and an optional mapping.
sections.why: Likely reason: rejects malformed model output before it reaches storage.
sections.watch_out: The 40-character minimum rejects short but valid quotes, so some real findings will be dropped with only a short note.

sections.name: Opportunity
sections.title: Full saved opportunity record
sections.what: Extends a finding into a saved opportunity by adding a stable id, industry, sources, related accounts, an optional mapping, locations, location research status and internal routing. The raw evidence list is removed.
sections.why: Likely reason: the stored form adds data the model does not write.
sections.watch_out: Locations and routing are optional, so any code reading them must handle their absence.

sections.name: OpportunityLocation
sections.title: A place linked to an opportunity
sections.what: Describes one mapped place: its label, country, coordinates, precision (project, locality, region or country), basis (project record or source research), and the source quote behind it.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets a map show where a signal is and how certain that location is.
sections.watch_out: Latitude and longitude are plain numbers, so swapping them would place the map pin wrongly without any error.

sections.name: LocationResearch, outputSchema
sections.title: Location status and the model reply shape
sections.what: Tracks whether a place lookup is pending, located, unresolved or failed, with notes. Also defines the shape of the model reply: a list of up to eight findings.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the status names.
sections.watch_out: The reply shape allows eight findings while the research prompt asks for four, so the two limits disagree.

summary: Defines the shapes and allowed values for findings, sources, opportunities and locations, and the limits that checked model output must meet.
purpose: Gives the rest of the Opportunity Map one agreed definition of what a finding and a saved signal look like.
why: Likely reason: keeps AI output and stored data within known bounds before they are saved.
how: 1. Lists the seven allowed themes. 2. Describes a cited source. 3. Defines the finding rules with length limits, allowed kinds and audiences, a priority from 1 to 100, and up to five quotes. 4. Defines a saved opportunity by extending a finding. 5. Defines a location and the state of location research. 6. Defines the wrapper shape of the model reply.
inputs: The mapping definitions from the mapping module.
outputs: Type definitions and validation rules used by the other files.
risks: Renaming a theme breaks saved findings that use the old name. The reply wrapper allows eight findings while the research prompt asks for four. A minimum quote length of 40 characters rejects short but valid quotes.
debug: If findings are rejected with a message naming a field, that field failed one of the limits here. Compare the model output with the limit. If a theme is reported as unknown, check the theme list.
